title: Do you offer group counseling and support for parents of children undergoing Speech Therapy?
metaTitle: Parent Group Counseling at Pinnacle Blooms Network | Support Community
description: Find out about the supportive parent group counseling sessions available at Pinnacle Blooms Network for parents of children undergoing Speech Therapy.
html: Yes, indeed! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we truly value the power of community. We host group sessions for parents where they can exchange their experiences, learn from each other's journeys, and come together to form a supportive network. These sessions aim to provide assurance that you're not alone in this journey - there's a whole community here to support you. For more information on our group counseling sessions, do get in touch with your nearest Pinnacle Blooms centre.
